name: Seared Black Pepper Steak with Creamy Mushroom-Spinach Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (454 g) bags frozen chopped spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and mince onion.
Once the pot is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms soften, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook until spinach is warmed through and sauce thickens slightly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy whipping cream
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and creamy veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!
